name: Ava Martin
education: B.S. in Computer Science, University of Colorado Boulder
summary: Site reliability engineer with 3 years of experience operating Linux and Kubernetes workloads, managing incidents end to end, and automating with Python, with observability delivered through Datadog rather than a Prometheus stack.
strengths: Runs incident management as primary on-call for health platform services
Strong Linux administration and Kubernetes troubleshooting
Automates operational tasks with Python and manages infrastructure with Terraform
gaps: Observability is done with Datadog - no hands-on Prometheus or Grafana deployment
Less experience designing SLOs and error budgets from scratch
Single-company experience so far - narrower production footprint
resumeText: Ava Martin is a Site Reliability Engineer at Clearwater Health with three years of experience keeping patient-facing services available. She owns incident management, operates Linux and Kubernetes infrastructure, and automates operations with Python. Her observability work runs on Datadog, and she is eager to extend her skills to the Prometheus and Grafana stack used by larger platform teams.
